blurb: Argument, hedging, evidence and register — aimed at IELTS and TOEFL writing.

fields.name: Argument & Claim
fields.note: Stating a position and holding it: assert, contend, posit, and the shape of a thesis.

fields.name: Hedging & Caution
fields.note: Saying something without overstating it. The half of academic English that marks a careful writer.

fields.name: Evidence & Method
fields.note: How a claim is supported — corroborate, replicate, and the vocabulary of showing your working.

fields.name: Cause & Consequence
fields.note: What follows from what: precipitate, engender, and the difference between correlation and cause.

fields.name: Comparison & Contrast
fields.note: Setting two things beside each other — notwithstanding, conversely, disproportionate.

fields.name: Register & Formality
fields.note: Words that mark writing as academic rather than spoken, and the traps of reaching too high.
